recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the remaining active-source contradiction for FHIR-11154 without broadening the reconciliation into unrelated stale details in the illustrative conformance table.
issue_request: FHIR-11154 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking that AllergyIntolerance.onset and AllergyIntolerance.reaction.onset have distinct short descriptions aligned with their definitions: allergy/intolerance identification for the resource-level onset and manifestation onset for reaction.onset.
initial_application: Git commit 87f224c94cabbf01ee3789f815f26c69d05608d4 applied the original fix to the old AllergyIntolerance spreadsheet source by changing AllergyIntolerance.onset from 'Date(/time) when manifestations showed' to 'Date(/time) when allergy or intolerance was identified.' The current StructureDefinition already has distinct shorts for AllergyIntolerance.onset[x] and AllergyIntolerance.reaction.onset, but the static AllergyIntolerance fragment embedded in source/conformance-rules.html still carried the old duplicate text.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/conformance-rules.html is an active Conformance page referenced by source/hierarchy.xml and other pages. FHIR-11089, resolved in the same Patient Care vote block, made AllergyIntolerance.onset polymorphic and helps explain the current onset[x] wording. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant community evidence conflicting with the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/conformance-rules.html so the visible description for the embedded AllergyIntolerance.onset row reads 'When allergy or intolerance was identified', matching the current authoritative StructureDefinition short. No StructureDefinition edit was needed because source/allergyintolerance/structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml was already correct.
source_changes: source/conformance-rules.html: changed the embedded AllergyIntolerance.onset example row description from 'Date(/time) when manifestations showed' to 'When allergy or intolerance was identified'.

related_jiras.note: Same Patient Care vote block later made AllergyIntolerance.onset polymorphic and explains the current onset[x] wording, but it did not require a separate decision for this seed.
